statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnoses on the claim are G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2
The denial reason is CO-197, indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
